ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and Mars at {H:1825954535000}

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.
